TC1.Hidden_Test_Description: Check default register values and masked write/read behavior across per-pin and group GPIO registers.
TC1.Hidden_Remarks: when reading default values the din value is becoming 1 automatically if we don't force any value,but if we force zero to din bit level sel becoming high,so that reding value not matched with expected value
TC1.Hidden_Test_Steps_Procedure: Entry: test_case(). 1) Call chk_rst_val(): for (i=0;i<CNT;i++): addr=addr_array[i]; if (skip_rst_array[i]==1) continue; if (read_mask_array[i]==0x00000000) continue; data_rd=read_reg(addr); data=(data_rd & 0xfffffffe); if (data==default_value_array[i]) pass; else { def_fail_cnt++; printf("RST : Failed Default value mismatch Addr :0x%x Expected : 0x%x\tRead_data : 0x%x\tDATA : 0x%x\n", addr, default_value_array[i], data, data_rd); } 2) Call chk_rd_wr(): unsigned int chk_val[6] = {0xffffffff,0xaaaaaaaa,0x55555555,0xf5f5f5f5,0xA5A5A5A5,0xffff0000}; For each pattern j in 0..5: data_wr=chk_val[j]; 2a) Write phase: for (i=0;i<CNT;i++): addr=addr_array[i]; if (skip_array[i]==1) continue; if (write_mask_array[i]==0x00000000) continue; write_reg(addr, (data_wr & write_mask_array[i])); 2b) Read/compare phase: for (i=0;i<CNT;i++): addr=addr_array[i]; if (skip_array[i]==1) continue; if (write_mask_array[i]==0x00000000) continue; if (read_mask_array[i]==0x00000000) continue; data_rd=(read_reg(addr) & read_mask_array[i]); wr_n=(write_mask_array[i] ^ 0xffffffff); exp_val=((data_wr & read_mask_array[i] & write_mask_array[i]) | (wr_n & read_mask_array[i] & default_value_array[i])); if (data_rd==exp_val) pass; else { wr_fail_cnt++; printf("Read_write : Failed : Write Read mismatch For Address %x, Expected value=0x%x\tRead value=0x%x\n", addr, exp_val, data_rd); } 3) If (def_fail_cnt>0 || wr_fail_cnt>0) finish(1); else finish(0).
TC1.Hidden_Validation_Acceptance_Criteria: Default check: data == default_value_array[i] for all readable, non-skipped addresses; else def_fail_cnt++. Write/read check: data_rd == ((data_wr & read_mask_array[i] & write_mask_array[i]) | ((write_mask_array[i] ^ 0xffffffff) & read_mask_array[i] & default_value_array[i])) for all readable/writable, non-skipped addresses; else wr_fail_cnt++. Overall PASS if def_fail_cnt==0 and wr_fail_cnt==0; finish(0) else finish(1).

TC2.Hidden_Test_Description: Negative-edge interrupt enable/handling per GPIO pin with group status verification and per-pin/group clear; system interrupt routing/clear is validated.
TC2.Hidden_Test_Steps_Procedure: Entry: test_case(). 1) Initialize: test_err=0. If GPIO0: GIC_EnableIRQ(87); if GPIO1: GIC_EnableIRQ(88). 2) Enable sysreg interrupt: If GPIO0: write_reg(MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1, LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1_GPIO0_INTR); if GPIO1: write_reg(MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1, LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1_GPIO1_INTR). 3) Drive all pads high initially: write_reg(0xA0243ffc, 0xffffffff). 4) Configure pins 8..39: for (i=0;i<32;i++): addr1=MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8+(i*4); write_reg(addr1, (1u<<20)|(1u<<18)|(1u<<16)); wait_on(10). 5) For each bit i: wr_val=(1u<<i); write_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GPIO_INTR_RAW_STCLR1, wr_val); write_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_EN1, wr_val); wait_on(10); int_pend=1; write_reg(0xA0243ffc, 0xffffffff); wait_on(30); write_reg(0xA0243ffc, ~wr_val); unsigned int timeout=5000; while (int_pend && timeout--) wait_on(10); if (timeout==0) { printf("ERROR: Timeout waiting for GPIO%u negedge interrupt\n", (unsigned)(i + 8)); test_err++; } 6) finish(test_err). ISR: Default_IRQHandler(): local_wr=(1u<<i); int_pend=0; write_reg(0xA0243ffc, 0xffffffff); raddr=MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8+(i*4); rdata=read_reg(raddr); if ((rdata & 0x1)!=0) test_err++; if ((rdata & 0x2)!=0x0) { rdata_grp=read_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_STS1); if ((rdata_grp & local_wr)==0) test_err++; raddr2=MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8+(i*4); write_reg(raddr2, (1u<<20)|(1u<<16)); write_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GPIO_INTR_RAW_STCLR1, local_wr); rdata_grp=read_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_STS1); if (rdata_grp!=0x0) test_err++; if GPIO0: write_reg(MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1, LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1_GPIO0_INTR); GIC_ClearIRQ(87); if GPIO1: write_reg(MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1, LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1_GPIO1_INTR); GIC_ClearIRQ(88); } else { test_err++; }
TC2.Hidden_Validation_Acceptance_Criteria: Per pin: timeout must not occur while waiting for interrupt; else test_err++. In ISR: DIN bit must be 0 after negedge; raw status bit must be set; masked group status must contain the active pin; after clearing per-pin raw (iclr) and group raw (RAW_STCLR1), masked group status must read 0; finally clear system raw status (RAW_STCR1) and acknowledge GIC. PASS if finish(test_err) is called with test_err==0.

TC3.Hidden_Test_Description: Positive-edge interrupt enable and handling for all pins with group status verification, per-pin raw clear, and system raw clear; includes timeout protection.
TC3.Hidden_Test_Steps_Procedure:
Entry: test_case(). 1) Enable GIC IRQ: if GPIO0 GIC_EnableIRQ(87); if GPIO1 GIC_EnableIRQ(88). 2) Enable sysreg interrupt: if GPIO0 write_reg(MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1, LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1_GPIO0_INTR); if GPIO1 write_reg(MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1, LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1_GPIO1_INTR). 3) For i=0..31: write_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8 + (i*4), 0x00020000) to enable posedge interrupt. 4) wait_on(10). 5) Configure input mode: write_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GPIO_IO_CTRL_GROUP1, 0x000000FF); write_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GPIO_IO_CTRL_GROUP2, 0x000000FF); write_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GPIO_IO_CTRL_GROUP3, 0x000000FF); write_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GPIO_IO_CTRL_GROUP4, 0x000000FF). 6) wait_on(10). 7) Enable group interrupt: write_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_EN1, 0xFFFFFFFF). 8) For i=0..31: write_reg(0xA0243ffc, 0x00000000); wait_on(10); int_pend=1; write_reg(0xA0243ffc, 0xFFFFFFFF); int timeout=2000; while ((int_pend==1) && (--timeout>0)) wait_on(10); if (timeout==0) { printf("ERROR: Timeout waiting for GPIO IRQ at i=%u
", i); test_err++; break; } write_reg(0xA0243ffc, 0x00000000); wait_on(10). 9) finish(test_err). ISR Default_IRQHandler(): wr_val=(1<<i); int_pend=0; rdata_grp=read_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_STS1); write_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_EN1, 0x00000000); if ((rdata_grp & (0xffffffff))!=0) pass; else { printf("ERROR: Group Interrupt not occured
"); test_err++; } for (j=0;j<32;j++) write_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8 + (j*4), 0x00010000); wait_on(2); rdata_grp=read_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_STS1); if (rdata_grp==0x0) pass; else { printf("ERROR : Group Interrupt clear failed: Interrupt value:%x
", rdata_grp); test_err++; } if GPIO0: write_reg(MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1, LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1_GPIO0_INTR); rdata=read_reg(MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1); if ((rdata & LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1_GPIO0_INTR)!=0) { printf("sysreg status not cleared : %0x
", MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1); test_err++; } if GPIO1: write_reg(MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1, LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1_GPIO1_INTR); rdata=read_reg(MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1); if ((rdata & LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1_GPIO1_INTR)!=0) { printf("sysreg status not cleared : %0x
", MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1); test_err++; } write_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_EN1, 0xFFFFFFFF); if GPIO0: GIC_ClearIRQ(87); if GPIO1: GIC_ClearIRQ(88).
TC3.Hidden_Validation_Acceptance_Criteria: Per pin: an interrupt must occur before the timeout expires; else test_err++. In ISR: masked group status must be nonzero when servicing, then must read zero after writing per-pin clear (iclr) across all pins; system RAW_STCR1 bit must clear on write with no residual bit set on readback; finally group enable is restored and GIC is cleared. PASS if finish(test_err) is called with test_err==0.
